scope: post-PnP exact-exposure joins, camera-ray u/v, event-time semantics, missingness, frame-local candidate-set changes, offline truth association, and deployable identity boundaries
research_state: predictor and multi-hypothesis tracker work remain paused

online_observation_contract.capture_boundary: deep-copied complete solved-armors set after solveArmors and before trackerUpdate
online_observation_contract.truth_schema: stage3-truth-v1 in a separate append-only stream
online_observation_contract.truth_join: offline exact four-field equality only; no nearest-frame or interpolation substitute
online_observation_contract.valid_event: an observation frame containing at least one finite valid camera_tvec_m
online_observation_contract.identity: observation_index and detector attributes are frame-local; no raw field is a persistent physical armor identity

formal_360_event_dataset.test_status: shards exist as protected assets; historical training/evaluation records state test_accessed=false

formal_360_distribution_navigation.point_level_authority: the 360 raw observation/truth JSONL streams and per-session qualification entries indexed by the historical catalog

adjacent_frame_diagnostics.interpretation: these are set/cardinality and detector-signature transitions only; they do not define physical births, deaths or identity switches

event_contract_history.status: accepted as the raw evidence boundary
event_contract_history.conclusion: append-only pre-tracker unordered sets preserve zero-candidate and greater-than-four-candidate frames; queue or durable I/O failure fails the sink

event_contract_history.status: accepted raw collection after invalid concurrent-run attempts were excluded
event_contract_history.conclusion: 360 successful sessions are the formal broad motion/distance source; failed and invalid runtime directories remain historical evidence
index-derived 5 ms time is forbidden; v2 shards and checkpoints remain archival
latest at most 200 valid events are ordered by true timestamp and left padded; empty frames do not consume an event but their elapsed time remains in the next event timestamp

event_contract_history.status: retained downstream A/B branch, not an active predictor task
event_contract_history.conclusion: missing exact future frames are masked, exact zero-candidate frames are visibility negatives, and greater-than-four-candidate frames are ambiguous; missing observations are never zero-valued labels

event_contract_history.status: accepted point-level evidence for current observation timing and availability
event_contract_history.conclusion: timestamps are irregular, source frame sequence frequently skips under latest-only delivery, candidate cardinality changes, and two combined runs contain no observation records

identity_and_association_boundary.offline_truth_assignment: relative_slot is derived only after exact truth join for labeling/scoring; target_id is simulator-run-local
identity_and_association_boundary.accepted_analysis_assignment: one-to-one nearest image ray among positive-facing truth plates with an explicit angular gate; this is an oracle-labeling procedure
rejected_or_limited_assignments: tracked_id, jump_flag, detector number and observation_index as physical identity
angular-only assignment without a facing constraint because opposite plates can share a camera ray
PnP-depth-only physical assignment because planar depth error can exceed slot separation
single hard cyclic identity as a safe deployment output
identity_and_association_boundary.current_decision: cyclic topology is useful structure, but no single hard physical identity is accepted; the planned multi-hypothesis C4 tracker remains paused

known_gaps.notable_contract_gap: tracker_world_transform_exposure_matched is false in every accepted 120-run observation record, so camera-frame u/v evidence cannot by itself certify an exposure-matched world transform
known_gaps.covariance_gap: candidate or pose uncertainty is not calibrated and is not part of the causal event contract

retention_policy: sample tables, exact empirical distributions, raw JSONL, shards, failed runs, invalid runs and superseded contracts are retained; summary percentiles are navigation only
